name: SOCIALFUEL
tagline: Search Search any brand or keyword across hundreds of thousands of live ads on Meta, Google and TikTok
description: Search Search any brand or keyword across hundreds of thousands of live ads on Meta, Google and TikTok. You get every ad a brand is running in one view, ranked by how long each has been live, so the proven winners rise to the top at a glance. Decode Open any single ad, or a brand's entire campaign, and get the strategy behind it in seconds: - **Hooks:** the opening doing the heavy lifting, and why it stops the scroll - **Transcripts:** the full spoken script of any video ad, timestamped and read
